messages:
maria: Heads-up: I'm kicking off bring-up for polaris-12b (HF mirror) — goal is a staging catalog entry, docs, quant experiments, and a low-risk canary rollout. Need owners for quant, docs/catalog, canary, and announcement copy.

jon: I can take quant experiments. Plan: PTQ 4-bit (nf4) + one 8-bit baseline for perf/quality comparison. Target: sub-1.5ms/token on p4d microbench (seq128) or show clear mem wins.

sophia: I’ll own docs + catalog entry. What exact metadata do you want in the catalog? HF id, license, sample prompts, eval scores, recommended profiles?

maria: Yes — exactly that. HF id: polaris/polaris-12b-v1 (private mirror). License: Apache-2.0. Params: 12B, rotary pos enc, ~28 transformer layers. I'll post eval artifacts shortly.

maria: Draft catalog YAML (staging):
```
name: polaris-12b
hf_id: polaris/polaris-12b-v1
params: "12B"
license: "Apache-2.0"
recommended_deployments:
  - hosted: false
  - dedicated: true
  - private: true
quant_profiles:
  - name: nf4-4bit-ptq
    latency_hint: low
    mem_saving: high
  - name: 8bit-llm-int8
notes: "Optimized for chat/instruction; some drop on long-context generation vs baseline. See evals in /eng-ml/polaris-12b/evals"
```

kevin: Canary plan idea: 1% traffic on a dedicated pool -> monitor latency, token cost, regression metrics (BLEU/ROUGE on internal evals + human rating sample), safety flags. Auto-fallback to 8-bit profile or prior model if regressions detected.

jon: Quick bench numbers (local microbench, seq128): FP16 baseline: 2.1 ms/token, mem ~23GB. NF4 4-bit PTQ: 1.3 ms/token, mem ~11GB. Quality: ~0.6% drop on instr-follow eval set, negligible on chat-turn tasks. Will run larger eval suite tomorrow.

sophia: Docs checklist (short): quickstart (SDK + REST example), catalog entry, cost-estimate table (tokens/sec / $), known regressions, recommended prompts, migration notes for dedicated/private. I'll draft a one-pager for Customer Success.

model-catalog-updater: model-catalog-updater: Draft entry created in staging: polaris-12b-v1 (catalog id: staging/polaris-12b-202803).

maria: Announcement blurb (draft): "Staging: polaris-12b — a 12B instruction-tuned model optimized for chat. Docs + sample prompts landing next week. Will open for limited canary on dedicated pools." @growth for blog/console banner?

kevin: I'll run the canary tomorrow 10:00 PST. Need deploy config. Quick deploy snippet:
```
instance_type: p4d.24xlarge
shard_count: 2
max_seq: 2048
batch_size: 8
quant_profile: nf4-4bit-ptq
monitoring: [latency, token_rate, human_eval_sample_rate=0.5%]
rollout: 1% -> 5% -> 25% over 48h if green
```

jon: Also flag: run safety+toxicity evals (OOD prompts) + evals on long completions (seq2seq). I’ll add automated eval jobs and post results to the evals bucket.

sophia: I'll prepare release notes + console 'what's new' and a short migration guide for teams using older 13B models.

maria: Owners confirmed: quant = jon, docs & catalog = sophia, canary = kevin, announcement draft = maria. Sync cadence: daily quick sync in eng-ml for 3 days post-canary start. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
